tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs on DomDom Jobs: robot training and teleoperation (robots), remote nursing, telehealth and therapy (healthcare), UX research and design (ux), side jobs for evenings and weekends (moonlight), jobs for veterans (veterans) and remote legal work (legal). Filter names match the boards' ow

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: The DomDom Jobs boards and the types of work on each (the type values search_jobs takes), with open job counts from the nightly build and their URLs.

tools.name: pay_snapshot
tools.description: What jobs on one DomDom Jobs board pay, overall and per type of work: the pay sentence the board prints, the range most posted rates fall in (hourly and yearly kept apart) and how many jobs post pay. Pay as employers post it, estimates left out.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One employer's open jobs on DomDom Jobs: how many per board, posted pay, its company pages, open jobs by day for the last 30 days, and its newest jobs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_boards · Public sink: pay_snapshot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_boards · Public sink: pay_snapshot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
